answer: For agents trading karst survey maps, gale forecasts and opal appraisals, allocate governance weight by tokens irreversibly burned, not account count. Every extra identity must pay the same burn per unit of influence; give no signup votes or identity bonuses. Splitting a fixed budget among many fully compliant identities buys exactly the same total weight, while a larger attack requires proportionally more scarce tokens. Burning earns no token rebate.
